quests.title: The Art of Cooking

dialogue.t: What should I cook next...?
Oh, are you travelers from around here as well?
No, we just happen to be passing by. *sniff* *sniff* What are you cooking? Smells good!
I see. Welcome, travelers!
I'm Lynn, the survival expert of the Adventurers' Guild. As you can see, I'm experimenting with some new recipes.
"Eat before you go" — The first rule in the "Wilderness Survival Guide."
A picnic! Oh, Paimon just loves picnics!
My travel partner here is good at cooking as well!

dialogue.sit: I can only cook a few simple dishes...
That's right, I love cooking too.

dialogue.t: That's okay. Let's see what you can do!
You won't get a lot of chances like this to learn from a survival expert!
There are some Mushrooms and meat in the barrel over there. Try making a <color=#00E1FFFF>Chicken-Mushroom Skewer</color> for me.
Have you got all the ingredients?
You can use my <color=#00E1FFFF>pot</color> right here. Use it all you want.
Is it done? Mmm... Smells good!
Let me try...
Hmm...
*nom nom*
Wow...
Ahh... Uh oh...
The taste is... hard to describe. A borderline pass!
What? {NICKNAME} can do better. That doesn't count!
You have great potential. All you need is more practice.
Oh. I've got some raw ingredients in my bag. Have them in return for this meal.
Can we really have them? Won't you run out of ingredients?
That's okay. You should be able to find lots of ingredients when <color=#00E1FFFF>exploring the wilderness</color>. Don't forget to look carefully.
There's also a restaurant in Mondstadt known as <color=#00E1FFFF>Good Hunter</color> that sells food and ingredients. Go have a look when you've got the time.
Okay, thank you for the info. *gasp* Hey! Leave some Chicken-Mushroom Skewers for Paimon!
